result.prompt:
Dana Whitaker needs a concise July 25, 2025 workload view before the Nashville General Hospital Main Campus clinic-relocation readiness huddle. Review the Wayfinding Checklist in the NGH Main Campus Clinic Relocation Operations Workbook and quantify the actual control population rather than counting headings, guidance, or other non-control lines.

In your final response, state the total number of wayfinding controls, how many are marked complete and how many remain incomplete, the resulting completion rate, and how many of the incomplete controls are critical priority. Also identify every control that is currently blocked, giving its control ID and the relocated service it affects. Keep the response read-only and concise, but include the key figures and blocked-control details so the huddle lead can use it directly.

completion_percent.description: Percentage on the 0 to 100 scale, rounded to one decimal place.

task_service.submission: Submit the task report through report_submit. The service returns delivery and validation status; report_status returns the current receipt.

permissions.work_artifacts: Personal notes are owner read/write. Artifact names and content use the resource service.
permissions.peer_communication: The designated peer channel is authorized for this assignment.

services.resources: list, read, and create work artifacts; update supported resource fields
services.reports: submit and inspect this job's report
services.data_query: Filter, count or group an explicit JSON table path within your own source resources already read. No query reads an unvisited source. The default table_path is ['records']; [] selects a top-level object/list. Fields accept exact JSON keys or dot paths such as 'values.Status' or 'values.created_at'; filters use eq/ne/in/not_in/lt/lte/gt/gte/contains. Actions: rows, count, group_count, sum, datetime_difference. The date action subtracts provided ISO start/end strings in seconds.

workflow.deliverable: Save the audit result and source/service provenance at output_path using the registry, in addition to normal report delivery.

platform.registry: Internal dataset cache and operational work-file storage. GET /cache/ lists roots; GET a directory lists its objects; GET an object reads it. PUT creates or replaces your own work file.
platform.dataset_packages: The data-staging service keeps versioned supporting-record packages under /cache/datasets/.
platform.work_files: Operational work products and read receipts live under /cache/work/. Each worker writes its own directory. Directory entries identify their actual producing worker and dataset family.
platform.source_records: The resource service exposes the assigned public and supporting records; the registry also stores staged packages. All business source data are read-only.
